evidence_scope: Pinned Pixel Composer source behavior only. This records source constraints and does not claim the engine implementation is complete.

source.verification: Each listed local file matched the official manifest byte count, SHA-256, and Git blob SHA-1.

verified_files.behavior: setDefValue records the constructor value, sets sepable only for an array with length greater than one, derives animVector from that value, constructs the ordinary animator, and clears per-axis animators.

createNewInput constructs Argument value as a scalar float with value 0. During refresh, selecting Vec2 changes a current value that is not a two-element array to [0,0], then sets float type and vector display. Constructor state and refreshed value therefore carry different evidence.

The generic Vector helper constructs with [] and def_length -1. Its getter returns the value without fixed-length normalization when def_length is -1; the animation getter uses the ordinary animator unless separate-axis mode is active.
The property-axis menu is offered only when the selected property reports sepable.

generic_vector_input_inventory.default_interpretation: All nine Vector records have an empty default field, meaning this inventory provides no concrete constructor value from which to infer initialized axes or a component count.

constraints_for_generalization: Retain generic-input constructor provenance separately from the current evaluated value. The HLSL input demonstrates that refresh can replace a scalar constructor value with a vector-shaped current value.
Retain the source getter kind because generic Vector getters skip fixed-length verification and may return nested data unchanged.
Do not infer zero defaults, two-axis initialization, or axis count from the current value when constructor evidence is absent.
Native generic saved overrides and arbitrary vector arities remain open behavior requiring separate source tracing. This evidence does not resolve them or mark the axis work complete.
